summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose receipt of a written notice from Nasdaq stating it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The company had previously been notified of non-compliance on May 8, 2026, but for ten consecutive business days from August 3 to August 14, 2026, its common stock closed at $1.00 per share or higher. The company believes it now meets all applicable listing requirements. This is a routine regulatory compliance update and does not constitute a special situation. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards.
